newsitem.title: USA: Paging Network names Freeze to top posts.
newsitem.headline: Paging Network names Freeze to top posts.

text.p: Paging Network Inc named John Freeze as its chairman president and chief executive officer, Tuesday.
Freeze replaces Pageing's founder George Perrin as chairman and Glenn Marschel, who resigned on Monday, as president and chief executive officer, the company said in a statement.
The company added that, Perrin, who founded the company in 1981, will remain with the company, sitting on its board of directors.

Freeze, who joined Paging's board of directors in 1995, was formerly the president and chief executive officer of Sprint Corp and chairman and chief executive officer of Centel Corporation which merged with Sprint in 1993, the company said.
